CASE CLOSED FOR E.R. 2023/03/04 09:12 ADVISE THAT TUG PRIDE REPORTS SHE HAS BEEN RIGHTED AND THAT THERE IS NO SIGN OF POLLUTION. PHOTOS TO BE FORWARDED TO ER. MARINE OCCURENCE REPORT ATTACHED. 2023/03/04 08:36 ADVISES THAT, AFTER TAKING A CLOSER LOOK AT TUG PRIDE, IT DOES NOT APPEAR ITS HULL HAS SUFFERED ANY SIGNIFICANT DAMAGE. THE STARBOARD SIDE OF THE HULL IS SITTING ON WOODEN PILES AND FORECASTED WINDS AND WATER LEVELS WILL NOT BE STRONG OR HIGH ENOUGH TO FLOAT PRIDE OFF WITHOUT ANY ASSISTANCE. PICTURES ATTACHED. 2023/03/04 06:51 ADVISES THAT, AS NOTICED BY THEIR WATCHKEEPING TEAM AROUND 2 AM THIS MORNING, THE TUG PRIDE/CFN6705, MOORED JUST AHEAD OF THE GRIFFON, HAS HEELED OVER AS A RESULT OF THE HIGH WATER LEVELS AND GOT HUNG UP ON ITS SHORE MOORING ARRANGEMENTS. AS A RESULT ITS OUTER PORT SIDE HAS DIPPED BELOW THE SURFACE. AT THE TIME OF THE OBSERVATION, THERE WAS NO ONE ON BOARD AND IT DOES NOT APPEAR THAT PRIDE HAD BEGUN FLOODING INSIDE. DECK LIGHTS WERE STILL ON AND POLLUTION WAS OBSERVED AROUND THE TUG. THE GRIFFON TEAM CONTACTED THE FERRY ST. CLAIR 5 WHICH IN TURN CONTACTED THE TUG PRIDE"S CAPTAIN, WHO WAS 4 HOURS AWAY AT THAT TIME - IT IS UNKNOWN IF HE WAS ON HIS WAY WHEN THIS REPORT WAS RECEIVED.
